title: Wake Up Slow Vacation Rental
meta_description: Wake Up Slow is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Wake Up Slow is a refined WaterColor retreat designed for relaxed, upscale coastal living with effortless access to everything the community has to offer. With a private pool, a courtyard built for entertaining, and complimentary use of a 6-seater electric cart and bikes, this home comfortably accommodates up to twelve guests across thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor spaces. Ideally positioned just steps from the Western Lake boardwalk and a short bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club and Sand Hill Frog Pool, Wake Up Slow places guests at the center of WaterColor’s most sought-after experiences. From quiet mornings on screened porches to afternoons spent poolside and evenings gathered in the courtyard, every detail is designed to make time here feel easy, connected, and memorable.Property Highlights Private Pool With Outdoor Courtyard Setting 6-Seater Electric Cart 6 Adult Cruiser Bikes Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included Steps to Western Lake Boardwalk and Beach Club Access 1-Minute Bike Ride to Sand Hill Frog Pool and Playground Private Courtyard With Summer Kitchen, Gas Grill, Outdoor Dining, and Lounge With TV Multiple Balconies Including Swing Bench Porch and Screened Porches Chef’s Kitchen With Wolf Double Oven, Sub-Zero Refrigerator, Wine Fridge, and Ice Maker Spacious Living Room With Large TV and Courtyard Access First-Floor King Suite With Screened Porch and Spa-Style Bath Carriage House With Private King Suite Outdoor Shower for Easy Post-Beach Rinse-Offs Parking for Up to 3 Vehicles Experience the Home Arrival at Wake Up Slow immediately sets the tone, with a welcoming front porch and a private courtyard that serves as the heart of the home. The newly completed private pool anchors this space, creating a secluded setting for relaxing swims and laid-back afternoons. Surrounding the pool, guests will find a summer kitchen with a built-in natural gas grill, outdoor dining, and a comfortable lounge area with a sectional sofa and TV—ideal for everything from casual lunches to evening gatherings. Inside, tall ceilings and an open, flowing layout create a bright and inviting atmosphere. The living room offers generous seating and a large TV, with French doors that open seamlessly to the courtyard for indoor-outdoor living. The chef’s kitchen is fully equipped for entertaining, featuring a Wolf double oven and range, Sub-Zero refrigeration, wine fridge, ice maker, and both Keurig and drip coffee makers. Nearby, the dining area comfortably seats ten, with additional seating at the breakfast bar. This level also includes a well-appointed king suite with a private screened porch overlooking a peaceful wooded area. The ensuite bathroom features dual vanities, a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and private water closet, creating a true retreat within the home. A powder room, laundry room, and workspace are also conveniently located on this floor. Upstairs, guests will find a mix of private suites and flexible sleeping arrangements designed for families and groups. Two king bedrooms each offer their own unique outdoor access, including screened porches and balconies, along with ensuite or semi-private baths. A bunk area provides additional sleeping for four, complete with built-in bunks and individual TVs, making it an ideal setup for younger guests. Set apart from the main home, the carriage house offers a private king suite with its own bathroom, giving guests added privacy and flexibility—perfect for extended family or couples traveling together.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Living Room Kitchen and Dining Area King Suite: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Screened Porch, Ensuite Bathroom With Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Powder Room Laundry Room Second Floor King Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Screened Porch, Ensuite Bathroom With Tub/Shower Combination King Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Balcony Access, Ensuite Bathroom With Walk-In Shower Bunk Area: Two Twin Bunks (Sleeps 4), Shared Hall Bathroom Carriage House King Suite: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom With Walk-In Shower Life in WaterColor Wake Up Slow is located within the award-winning WaterColor community, known for its blend of coastal charm, natural beauty, and thoughtfully designed amenities. Guests are just steps from the Western Lake boardwalk, providing easy access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Gulf shoreline. The nearby Sand Hill Frog Pool and playground are only a short bike ride away, while Camp WaterColor and additional community pools offer activities for all ages. With included access to WaterColor’s premier amenities, along with nearby shopping, dining, and the neighboring town of Seaside, this home offers a seamless balance of relaxation and activity along 30A.
